basis: Focused AP18 post-login diagnostic work order; no unchanged login retries

startup.Agent_contract: No separate startup registration found. Launching the main creates the exact Agent in both tested runner modes. No invented Agent arguments or persistent startup change.

probes.local_IPC: Owned UNIX sockets and loopback TCP socket metadata observed; no payload inspected; peer protocol readiness unproved
probes.result: natural exit 0; positive cgroup cleanup after about 35.6 seconds
probes.note: No main was launched during this probe. Natural Agent exit does not establish Agent failure.

probe_limitations: The first observer incorrectly counted wrapper command arguments as image identity. Independent mapped-device/inode snapshots established one real main and one Agent. Commit 87c0bdec removes argument matching and never reads command lines.
An Agent-only probe completed before cancel; the old CLI reported the already collected unit missing. Commit 87c0bdec makes completed cancellation idempotent.
Full initialization and runinprefix both reached login. No post-login success or runner-mode fix follows from this non-login comparison.

final_login.route: exact main, runinprefix, diagnostic channels enabled
final_login.operator_result: Login window closes/minimizes; no library, error or signal appears

exception.classification: Fatal access violation in the ASC main process; outer 5 is not an observed Arturia Error 05
exception.DLL_or_symbol: unresolved: loaded module base/range map was not retained; preferred PE bases do not resolve relocated fault address

relative_timeline_ms.clock: Python time.monotonic_ns, relative to first journal event; sampled observation, not exact Windows exit clock

final_login.clock_caveat: Wine timestamp orders exception and NtTerminateProcess in the Windows trace. It is not directly subtracted from Python monotonic time. Membership sampling is nominally 100 ms plus observer scheduling/collection; exact-image refresh is 1 s.

id_ascd_metadata.scope: Existence/size/mtime only; absence at samples does not exclude transient creation/deletion.

established: The main launch starts the Agent; it is not simply absent.
Both registered images exist before operator login.
ASC main suffers a fatal access violation and disappears before Agent.
The supervisor retains the operation until the cgroup is empty and does not kill the handoff in this attempt.
No process remains with an invisible library window after failure.
not_established: Exact DLL/function at the relocated crash address
Whether account processing, a runtime function, or earlier corruption triggers the fault
ASC main-to-Agent IPC semantics or successful authenticated handoff
A repair for the ASC crash
That the previous discarded-log attempts had the same crash

next_boundary: Resolve the captured fault against an actual loaded-module map / symbolized Windows stack before choosing a compatibility change. No further unchanged login attempt is authorized.
